id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

maxRepeatNum.description: loop may be occurred multiple times, this value defines limitations for the loop to repeat.

letteringDepth.description:
defines whether the loop should get letters from the parent loop name.

For example, loop 1000A contains nested loop with loopId 2000 and following name:
- 2000 if letteringDepth < 1
- 2000A if letteringDepth >= 1

title:
This c3typ represents configuration for x12 document loop - set of segments that represents an entity
with a business value. Example may be a 'submitter' entity that contains personal data in segment 'NM1' and
contact information in segment 'PER'.
If business entity should contain some sub-entity, it is represented as nested loop.

@see Segment
name: X12Loop
